supportText: Remember the sky that you were born under, know each of the star’s stories. Remember the moon, know who she is. Remember the sun’s birth at dawn. [...] Remember your birth, how your mother struggled to give you form and breath [...] Remember the earth whose skin you are: red earth, black earth, yellow earth, white earth brown earth, we are earth. Remember the plants, trees, animal life who all have their tribes, their families, their histories, too [...] Remember you are all people and all people are you. Remember you are this universe and this universe is you. Remember all is in motion, is growing, is you.
